k.alim: Kahaniyan aur duain Quran aur sahih ahadees se li gayi hain — kisi alim se tasdeeq karein.
k.s.nuh.b: Nabi Nuh (AS) bohat saal tak logon ko pyar se Allah ki taraf bulate rahe.|Allah ne unhein ek bari kashti banane ka hukm diya.|Phir bohat baarish aayi aur har taraf paani hi paani ho gaya.|Jo log Allah ki baat maan kar kashti mein baithe, aur janwaron ke jode bhi, sab mehfooz rahe.
k.s.nuh.m: Allah ki baat maanna hamesha acha hota hai.
k.s.yunus.b: Nabi Yunus (AS) ek kashti se samandar mein gir gaye.|Ek bari machhli ne unhein nigal liya.|Machhli ke pait ke andhere mein unhon ne Allah ko pukara: “La ilaha illa Anta, Subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimeen.”|Allah ne unki dua suni aur unhein mehfooz bahar nikaal diya.
k.s.yunus.m: Mushkil mein Allah ko yaad karo — woh hamesha sunta hai.
k.s.naml.b: Nabi Sulaiman (AS) apne lashkar ke saath ja rahe the.|Ek nanhi cheenti ne kaha: “Cheentiyo! Apne gharon mein chali jao, kahin kuchli na jao!”|Nabi Sulaiman (AS) uski baat sun kar muskuraye aur Allah ka shukr ada kiya.|Unhon ne cheentiyon ko koi nuqsan nahi pahunchaya.
k.s.naml.m: Chhote se chhote janwar ka bhi khayal rakho, aur Allah ka shukr karo.
k.s.dog.b: Hamare Nabi ﷺ ne ek kahani sunayi.|Ek aadmi ko raste mein bohat pyaas lagi; usne kunwein mein utar kar paani piya.|Bahar aaya to dekha ke ek kutta pyaas se geeli mitti chaat raha hai.|Usne apne mozay mein paani bhar kar kutte ko pilaya. Allah ko ye baat itni pasand aayi ke usne us aadmi ko maaf kar diya.
k.s.dog.m: Janwaron par reham karo — Allah reham karne walon se pyar karta hai.
k.s.camel.b: Ek dafa hamare Nabi ﷺ ek baagh mein gaye.|Wahan ek oont tha jo unhein dekh kar rone laga.|Nabi ﷺ ne pyar se uske sar par haath phera to woh chup ho gaya.|Phir unhon ne oont ke maalik se farmaya: is janwar ke baare mein Allah se daro, ise bhooka na rakho aur is se zyada kaam na lo.
k.s.camel.m: Janwar bhi Allah ki makhlooq hain — unke saath narmi karo.
k.s.ibrahim.b: Nabi Ibrahim (AS) ki qaum patthar ke buton ki pooja karti thi.|Unhon ne pyar se samjhaya ke ye but na sun sakte hain, na faida de sakte hain.|Ek din jab log bahar gaye, unhon ne buton ko tod diya aur sirf sab se bada but chhod diya.|Logon ne poocha to farmaya: “Isi bade se poochh lo, agar ye bolte hain!” Log samajh gaye ke but kuch nahi kar sakte, phir bhi ziddi rahe.|Unhon ne Nabi Ibrahim (AS) ko aag mein daal diya.|Allah ne hukm diya: “Aye aag! Ibrahim par thandi aur salamati wali ban ja.” Aur woh bilkul mehfooz rahe.
k.s.ibrahim.m: Sirf Allah ki ibadat karo aur sach par himmat se qaim raho — Allah hifazat karta hai.
k.s.ibrahim.q1: Log kis ki pooja karte the?
k.s.ibrahim.q1o: Patthar ke buton ki|Sooraj ki|Darakhton ki
k.s.ibrahim.q2: Nabi Ibrahim (AS) ne kaun sa but chhoda?
k.s.ibrahim.q2o: Sab se chhota|Sab se bada|Koi nahi
k.s.ibrahim.q3o: Aur garam ho gayi|Thandi aur salamati wali ban gayi|Kuch nahi hua
k.s.yusuf.b: Nabi Yusuf (AS) ke bhaiyon ne hasad mein unhein ek kunwein mein daal diya.|Ek qafila unhein Misr le gaya. Wahan bohat mushkilein aayin, yahan tak ke jail bhi jaana pada, magar woh sabr aur sachai par qaim rahe.|Allah ne unhein izzat di aur woh Misr ke khazanon ke nigraan ban gaye.|Saalon baad qahat pada aur wahi bhai ghalla lene unke paas aaye.|Nabi Yusuf (AS) badla le sakte the, magar unhon ne farmaya: “Aaj tum par koi malamat nahi. Allah tumhein maaf kare.”
k.s.yusuf.m: Badla lene ki taqat ho tab bhi maaf kar dena bohat bari naiki hai.
k.s.yusuf.q1: Bhaiyon ne Nabi Yusuf (AS) ko kahan daala?
k.s.yusuf.q2: Mushkilon mein unhon ne kya kiya?
k.s.yusuf.q2o: Sabr kiya aur sach par rahe|Shikayatein kin|Jhagra kiya
k.s.yusuf.q3: Jab bhai aaye to unhon ne kya kiya?
k.s.yusuf.q3o: Badla liya|Maaf kar diya|Wapas bhej diya
k.s.musa.b: Firaun ek zalim badshah tha jo Bani Israel par zulm karta tha.|Allah ke hukm se Nabi Musa (AS) raat ko apni qaum ko le kar nikle.|Aage samandar tha aur peeche Firaun ka lashkar. Log ghabra kar bole: “Hum to pakde gaye!”|Nabi Musa (AS) ne poore yaqeen se kaha: “Hargiz nahi! Mera Rab mere saath hai, woh mujhe raasta dikhayega.”|Allah ne hukm diya ke samandar par apna asa (laathi) maaro — samandar phat gaya aur beech mein sookha raasta ban gaya.|Sab mehfooz paar ho gaye.
k.s.musa.m: Jab sab raaste band lagein, tab bhi Allah par bharosa rakho.
k.s.musa.q2o: Hum pakde gaye|Mera Rab mere saath hai|Wapas chalo
k.s.musa.q3o: Jam kar barf ban gaya|Beech mein sookha raasta ban gaya|Kuch nahi hua
k.s.bilal.b: Hazrat Bilal (RA) Makkah mein ek ghulam the.|Jab unhon ne Islam qubool kiya to unke maalik ne unhein sakht takleefein dein — garam ret par litaya aur upar bhaari patthar rakha.|Woh har takleef mein bas yahi kehte rahe: “Ahad, Ahad!” — Allah ek hai!|Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) ne unhein khareed kar azad kar diya.|Baad mein Nabi ﷺ ne unhein azaan dene ke liye chuna — unki buland awaaz mein azaan goonjti thi.
k.s.bilal.m: Imaan par mazbooti se qaim raho, chahe mushkil ho.
k.s.bilal.q1: Hazrat Bilal (RA) takleef mein kya kehte the?
k.s.bilal.q2o: Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA)|Ek tajir ne|Unke maalik ne khud
k.s.bilal.q3: Baad mein Nabi ﷺ ne unhein kis kaam ke liye chuna?
k.s.guest.b: Ek dafa Nabi ﷺ ke paas ek bhooka mehmaan aaya.|Ek Ansari Sahabi use apne ghar le gaye, magar ghar mein sirf bachon jitna khana tha.|Unhon ne bachon ko pyar se sula diya aur khane ke waqt chiragh bujha diya, taake mehmaan samjhe ke woh bhi kha rahe hain.|Mehmaan ne pet bhar kar khana khaya aur ghar wale bhooke so gaye.|Subah Nabi ﷺ ne bataya ke Allah unke is amal se bohat khush hua, aur Quran ki ayat utri: “Woh doosron ko apne upar tarjeeh dete hain, chahe khud zaroorat mand hon.”
k.s.guest.m: Doosron ka khayal apne se pehle rakhna Allah ko bohat pasand hai.
k.s.guest.q2o: Sone ke liye|Taake mehmaan aaram se pet bhar kar khaye|Tel bachane ke liye
k.s.guest.q3o: Kuch nahi|Khush hua aur ayat utri|Mehmaan ko bheja
k.s.kab.b: Hazrat Ka'b bin Malik (RA) ek safar (Ghazwa-e-Tabuk) mein bina kisi uzr ke peeche reh gaye.|Jab Nabi ﷺ wapas aaye to kuch logon ne jhoote bahane bana diye.|Hazrat Ka'b (RA) ne socha: main jhoot nahi bolunga. Unhon ne saaf sach bata diya ke mera koi uzr nahi tha.|Kuch arsa unke liye bohat mushkil guzra, magar woh sabr se taubah karte rahe.|Phir Allah ne Quran mein unki taubah qubool hone ka elaan farmaya. Unhon ne kaha: “Allah ne mujhe sach ki wajah se najaat di.”
k.s.kab.m: Sach bolo, chahe mushkil lage — sach hi kaamyabi tak le jaata hai.
k.s.kab.q1o: Jhoota bahana banaya|Saaf sach bata diya|Chhup gaye
k.s.kab.q2: Mushkil waqt mein unhon ne kya kiya?
k.s.kab.q2o: Sabr aur taubah|Ghussa kiya|Shehar chhod diya
k.s.kab.q3o: Allah ne unki taubah qubool ki|Kuch nahi hua|Sab bhool gaye
